title: Help Nursing Students Develop Clinical Reasoning Skills, Competence and Confidence with vSim® for Nursing | Laerdal Medical
meta_description: Engaging in virtual simulation scenarios, students develop clinical reasoning skills, competence, and confidence as they care for the patient. vSim for Nursing, co-developed by Laerdal Medical and Wolters Kluwer, helps prepare for and reinforce the lessons of high-fidelity patient simulators. In a safe, realistic environment, nursing students hone their prioritization, clinical reasoning, and decision-making skills.
